stage: C3X 0.9.0-G10-P16 — Prospective Chess-Context-Conditional Intervention Router, Frozen Context→Grammar Assignment, Phase×Branching×Tactical Policy Partition, Grammar-Specific Structural/Preference Positivity, Global-vs-Routed Grammar Falsification, Held-Out Balanced Chess-Ecology Validation, Cross-Source Routing Stability, Frozen Defect-Replay Re-entry & Context-Adaptive Intervention Policy Experiment
question: Can a context-routed intervention policy, frozen from P15 engine-free structural feasibility alone, outperform the single global G2 grammar on repo-unseen held-out balanced chess worlds without using P15 preference outcomes to choose the route?

development_router.route_rule: Within each context cell having >=3 P15 admitted pair positions, choose the first grammar in G0→G4 whose structural chain availability fraction is >=0.50. If none qualifies, ABSTAIN. No coarser backoff.
development_router.validation_domain: Only cells assigned a non-ABSTAIN grammar before held-out source acquisition.

comparator.name: GLOBAL_G2
comparator.reason: P15 minimal global structural grammar; fixed before held-out validation.

pair_freeze.instrument: Inherited P14/P16 baseline qualification and unordered near-equal pair rule.
pair_freeze.pair_rule: At least two engines stably score both A/B within 50cp and contextual baseline bestmove belongs to pair.

dual_policy_test.structural_chain_generation: Same P15 edit universe and collateral caps; only control-matching grammar differs.
dual_policy_test.preference_support: TARGET/SUBSET/SHAM all preserve legal A/B and repeated isolated non-mate gap <=50cp for >=2 active engines.
dual_policy_test.router_primary_metric: preference-supported positions / all held-out admitted pair positions

success_gate.superiority_rule: ROUTED must have strictly more preference-supported held-out positions than GLOBAL_G2; report exact paired discordance counts without post-hoc significance threshold.
success_gate.cross_source_stability: ROUTED chain fraction must be >=0.25 separately in each held-out source.

stage_c.allocation: At most one ROUTED-positive position per context cell×source, prioritize more supporting engines then lower collateral then lexical id.
stage_c.measurement: Frozen P10/P11 opportunity-transition measurement and P11 semantic alignments.

claim_ceiling: Development-plus-heldout validation of context-conditioned intervention policy.
Repo-unseen held-out source arms are not automatically external fresh-confirmation authority.
No objective chess truth, human cognition, or engine-internals mechanism claim.
